stepTitle: Antiballistic missiles (ABMs) are designed to have very large accelerations so that they may intercept fast-moving incoming missiles in the short time available. What is the takeoff acceleration of a $$10{, }000\, \text{kg}$$ ABM that expels $$196\, \text{kg}$$ of gas per second at an exhaust velocity of $$2.50\times10**{3}\,\text{m/s}$$ (in $$\text{m/s}**2)$$?
